high_level_description: A single golden retriever galloping left-to-right across a wide 1600x900 canvas with a small red tennis ball ahead of it, on a plain near-white background.

style_description.lighting: Flat, even illumination — no shadows or highlights

compositional_deconstruction.background: Plain near-white rectangle filling entire canvas

elements.desc: Golden retriever silhouette in mid-gallop: body as horizontal rounded-rectangle, head as right-facing ellipse, four slender angled legs extending forward and backward, all in solid gold
Red tennis ball as a solid circle, centered at (1300,450), radius 30, placed 100px ahead of dog's snout, fully separated
